# ReAgent

> Composable React AI agent — an in-app chat, a conversation tree and a full settings surface (model, prompt, skills, tools, MCP), built on `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core` and `pi-ai`. The agent loop runs entirely in the browser; API keys and conversations stay on the device.

- Package: `@liyu1981/reagent` (npm)
- Repository: https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent
- Documentation: https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs
- Live demos: https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/demos
- Integration skill (for coding agents): https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/skill.md

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/introduction): what ReAgent is, architecture and storage model.
- [Installation](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/installation): install the package and set up Tailwind v4.
- [Quick start](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/quick-start): render the preset and configure a model.
- [Styling](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/styling): `@source`, design tokens and surfaces.
- [Theming](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/theming): dark mode, the `theme` prop, i18n overrides.
- [Host integrations](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/host-integrations): markdown, custom tools, uploads, editor bridge.
- [Models & providers](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/models): every pi-ai provider, credentials, verification.
- [Tools & skills](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/tools-and-skills): descriptors, the skill loader, MCP.
- [Sessions & persistence](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/sessions): the conversation tree and IndexedDB.
- [Multiple agents & storage](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/multiple-agents): isolate agents with `storagePrefix`.
- [Components & props](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/components): the full `<ReAgent>` props table and UI parts.
- [Headless usage](https://liyu1981.github.io/reagent/#/docs/headless): build a custom UI on the provider and hooks.

## Source

- [src/index.ts](https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent/blob/main/src/index.ts): public API barrel.
- [styles.css](https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent/blob/main/styles.css): Tailwind tokens and glass surfaces.
- [docs/](https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent/tree/main/docs): the documentation markdown.
- [site/src/demos/](https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent/tree/main/site/src/demos): the two live demo sources.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository conventions.

- [RELEASING.md](https://github.com/liyu1981/reagent/blob/main/RELEASING.md): how releases and npm publishing work.
